method: Fixed initial holdings on common genuine daily EUR marks. New Current holdings are not retrospective purchases. Asset-only target perturbations retain every other Current position; targets belong to saved model versions, not new orders. Sale variants reduce actual Current by exactly10/50/100percent and retain proceeds at the latest dated EUR quote as constant zero-return cash throughout the descriptive history; latest value is conserved, with no fees, reoptimisation or assumed reinvestment. Existing actual cash, bonds and savings notes are excluded from this shares/funds diagnostic. Fractional percentages are theoretical, not lot-rounded executable orders. netSD uses the full reference network with a candidate-dependent denominator. Regime masks are retrospective diagnostics, not IS/OOS strategies. Frontier lines are observed nondominated candidate envelopes, not freshly solved optimisation frontiers.
